# Prosopo

> > Prosopo provides GDPR-compliant, privacy-first bot protection and CAPTCHA alternatives through Procaptcha, defending against scraping, spam, and cyber threats without compromising user data.

Prosopo offers enterprise-grade bot defense solutions including Procaptcha (a privacy-respecting alternative to Google reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha), with integrations for WordPress, React, Vue, Angular, and other frameworks. The company emphasizes GDPR compliance, open-source transparency, and accessibility in cybersecurity.

## Key Topics

- Procaptcha
- GDPR compliance
- Bot protection
- Privacy-first CAPTCHA
- reCAPTCHA alternative
- hCaptcha alternative
- WordPress integration
- React/Vue/Angular/Svelte frameworks
- Spam prevention
- API security
- Behavioral analysis
- Form protection
- Data protection
- Open-source security
- Enterprise bot defense
